promotion.reason: Qualification is complete and the owner approved it on 2026-09-10. The 2.0.6 image was rebuilt 2026-08-08, publishes linux/amd64 and arm64 among seven architectures, and a real install proved encrypted paste creation in the browser, reopening after restart and after a keep-data reinstall, managed-folder writes as the documented non-root UID 65534/GID 82, and complete removal on delete-data. It asks for no setup answers, so there is no credential for a person to get wrong. Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine only; the other six architectures are registry metadata rather than runs.

data_storage: Local Store managed folder / privatebin, holding every paste
risk_notes: Creates one Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.

Pastes are encrypted and decrypted in your browser, so the app stores only ciphertext. The decryption key travels in the fragment of the link, which means anyone you give the whole link to can read that paste.
Keeps pastes in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves them there; deleting data removes them permanently and no copy is kept elsewhere.
The container writes as UID 65534 and GID 82 rather than as root.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
